rows.label: tlk70000067_03_msg0001
rows.name:
My inn may be small, but
I still get customers.

rows.label: tlk70000067_03_msg0002
rows.name:
I get to hear plenty of stories
from travelers, too. It's one
of life's little pleasures...

rows.label: tlk70000067_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Never understood what the
deal with Acedia is though.

rows.label: tlk70000067_03_msg0004
rows.name:
I've heard that while God's salvation
is spread, scientists also come and go
from the Holy See.

rows.label: tlk70000067_03_msg0005
rows.name:
That combination of "science and God"
just doesn't sit right with me.

rows.label: tlk70000067_03_msg0006
rows.name:
Science is about using human effort to
uncover how the world works, right? It
seems incompatible with salvation...

rows.label: tlk70000067_03_msg0007
rows.name:
Maybe I only feel that way because I'm
uneducated.
